name: Abandon All Artichokes

categories.label: Won (hand free of Artichokes at end of own turn)
categories.hint: Refill your hand at end of your turn; if no Artichokes, you win immediately

winCondition: The first player who refills their hand at the end of their own turn and has no Artichoke cards in it wins immediately. A hand without Artichokes mid-turn does not count.

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when a player draws an Artichoke-free hand at end of turn

notes: family: race-to-goal. No points and no tiebreaker (win is immediate on one player's turn). Player count 2-4 from publisher info, not from the rule PDF.

sources.title: How to play Abandon All Artichokes (UltraBoardGames)
